head.t: SBC Medical joins growing list of healthcare cyber victims in 2026
head.x: SBC Medical is the latest healthcare company hit by a cyberattack, one of about a dozen this year that include Stryker, Boston Scientific and McKesson. Detail is from the newsletter summary; the MDDI page is bot-blocked.

head.t: Boston Scientific prices $3.0bn and €4.25bn senior notes to fund its pending $14.5bn Penumbra acquisition
head.x: Boston Scientific announced on 19/11/2026 the pricing of $3.0bn of US dollar senior notes and, through American Medical Systems Europe B.V., €4.25bn of euro notes, expected to close on 1 December 2026, to finance the cash consideration for its acquisition of Penumbra, Inc.

head.t: Obsidio conformable embolic achieves 100% technical and clinical success in real-world registry
head.x: Obsidio (Boston Scientific) conformable embolic was safe and effective across a broad range of target vessels in the OCCLUDE registry, with 100% technical and clinical success and a low rate of major adverse events (MAEs), according to findings from a multicentre real-world study published in the Journal of Vascular…

head.t: Reduced-dose NOACs and aspirin non-inferior to DAPT for six-month outcomes after LAA closure
head.x: Boston Scientific has announced positive six-month primary endpoint results from the SIMPLAAFY randomised controlled trial of the Watchman FLX Pro left atrial appendage closure (LAAC) device.

f.t: Why do Cook Medical’s DES and Boston Scientific’s DES produce such different restenotic morphology?
